purpose: Teach: 明子/大介/康弘/ナターシャ/ミミ/目新しい/マジメ/思ひ

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがご友人の明子さんとお茶されてたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad was having tea with Akiko, a friend of his.
lines.style: Warm, conversational tone. Light lift on the name Akiko, as though sharing a small observation about his day. Not quite confiding, but intimate in the way mothers share details with their children. Gentle pace.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと大介おじさんに会いに行ったよ
lines.en: Mom, I went to visit Dad and Uncle Daisuke.
lines.style: Quiet pride in having done something grown-up. Small, genuine smile in the voice. No performance, just matter-of-fact contentment. Slightly eager to be heard.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「康弘叔父様にお元気でね」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad said to send his regards to Uncle Yasuo.
lines.style: Thoughtful delivery, like she's remembering something her husband said with care. Slight pause before the name Yasuo, honoring the formal relationship. Tender without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんとペットのナターシャちゃんを撫でたよ
lines.en: Mom, I got to pet Natasha with Dad.
lines.style: Quiet delight. The kind of small-voice happiness that comes from petting something soft. No urgency, just the simple pleasure of sharing a nice moment. Softly genuine.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがオペラ「ラ・ボエーム」のミミ役を語って下さったわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad told me about the role of Mimì in La Bohème.
lines.style: Appreciative, like she's recalling something her husband shared with genuine care and knowledge. Slight reverence in the mention of the opera. Warm but composed, as if honoring his thoughtfulness.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんと目新しい食材を試したよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad and I tried some new ingredients together.
lines.style: Eager but measured. Voice brightens on 'new ingredients' — curiosity shining through without overselling it. The naturalness of a child who felt included in something the adults were doing.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが「マジメな性格は宝物」って仰ってたわ
lines.en: Sho — your dad told me that having a serious nature is a treasure.
lines.style: Gentle, almost wondering. She's turning over this gift of wisdom in her mind as she speaks it to her son. Not lecturing — passing along something her husband gave, carefully, to both of them.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、ぼく、お父さんに古文の「思ひ」、つまり「思い」の古い書き方を教えて頂いたよ
lines.en: Mom, Dad taught me the old way of writing 'omoi' — how people used to write it in classical Japanese.
lines.style: Quiet pride in having learned something old and elegant. The slight formality of the language learning sits naturally in a child's voice — earnest without strain. Closes gently, as if settling the learning into himself.
